Stale copy of ~/.claude.json (%USERPROFILE%\.claude.json on Windows) taken before onboarding; Claude Code keeps its documented backups under ~/.claude/backups, so this one has no reader, but it can hold account and MCP settings: confirm the live .claude.json is intact first
pytest cacheprovider state (last-failed, step-wise), written to the rootdir pytest ran in; regenerated by the next run; native clear: pytest --cache-clear
Ruff lint and format result cache, written to the directory Ruff took as project root; regenerated by the next run; native clear: ruff clean

Playwright CLI output folder (snapshots, screenshots, traces) written to the folder the CLI ran in; sessions live elsewhere, but the output may hold credentials, so confirm nothing in it is evidence still being used

tj/n prefix (N_PREFIX=$HOME/.n): n/versions is a download cache, but bin, include, lib and share hold the active Node.js and its global packages; confirm N_PREFIX no longer points here and nothing on PATH resolves into it, else use n prune
pip's legacy per-user config directory ($HOME/.pip) holding no pip.conf; current pip keeps config in ~/.config/pip and its cache in ~/.cache/pip (pip cache purge)

Directory named for the Biome toolchain; current Biome keeps its cache and logs in the platform cache directory and writes nothing here, so the writer is unproven: inspect its contents before treating it as Biome state
Semgrep CLI user data folder holding no settings.yml (where the API token is stored); the rest is the semgrep.log run log
Storybook per-user folder (settings.json, instances/), recreated with defaults; onboarding and checklist state resets. A folder with a main.* file is a project's Storybook config and never matches
NVIDIA CUDA JIT compute cache (~/.nv/ComputeCache, CUDA_CACHE_PATH relocates it); regenerated on the next CUDA launch; confirm no CUDA process is running
NVIDIA CUDA JIT compute cache (%APPDATA%\NVIDIA\ComputeCache, CUDA_CACHE_PATH relocates it); regenerated on the next CUDA launch; confirm no CUDA process is running

dotnet new template engine settings and cache (%USERPROFILE%\.templateengine on Windows); the cache rebuilds (dotnet new --debug:rebuild-cache), but packages/ holds templates installed with dotnet new install, which are lost

mcp-remote OAuth token store (MCP_REMOTE_CONFIG_DIR relocates it) that no home-level MCP config names; deleting it forces re-authentication. Project .mcp.json and .cursor/mcp.json files are not read, so confirm no project config still runs mcp-remote
Daily stamp the Ubuntu update-motd profile script writes so the login MOTD shows once a day; recreated at the next login unless ~/.hushlogin exists
landscape-sysinfo log directory (sysinfo.log) the Ubuntu login MOTD writes for a non-root user; recreated at the next login unless ~/.hushlogin exists
